messages:
maria: kicking off change window — rolling v2.18.0 canary (10%) across eu-west/us-east. Deploy ID: deploy-2026-04-xx-001

deploy-bot: [deploybot] started rollout deploy-2026-04-xx-001 -> v2.18.0
Routes: embed-service, api-gateway
Canary: 10% traffic to v2.18.0

alex: noted. I'll watch SLO dashboards and error budgets :eyes:

sre-alerts: [ALERT] embed-service (eu-west) p95 = 1800ms (threshold 1200ms) — spike started at 12:34 UTC. 5xx rate 0.8% (baseline 0.1%)

cheng: seeing tail latency growth on embed-worker logs, KV cache miss rate up ~3x. Looks correlated with kvcache heatmap enabled in v2.18.0

maria: can we pause traffic shift? pin canary back to v2.17.9 in eu-west if not healthy.

alex: pausing further traffic shift. deploy-bot: hold traffic shift

deploy-bot: command accepted: hold-rollout deploy-2026-04-xx-001
Traffic shift paused at 10% for eu-west

maria: quick rollpin command, do we have automation for pin?

cheng: run the pin with redwoodctl —
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --service embed-service --region eu-west --version v2.17.9 --reason "p95 spike"
```

ops-bot: executed redwoodctl: pin applied, routing updated. New state: eu-west pinned to v2.17.9, canary v2.18.0 traffic removed in eu-west

alex: monitoring — p95 dropping back to 700ms after pin :thumbsup:

maria: good. Marking as rollback decision for eu-west only. We'll continue canary in us-east with caution. Please add short note to release notes about kvcache heatmap change.

cheng: noted, opening PR to revert heatmap flag in v2.18.0; will include perf numbers and regression test.

maria: thanks all. I'll update the deploy ticket, notify product and schedule a follow-up postmortem if needed. End of thread.
